en: A part of a play or film that takes place in one place; or the place where something happens; or a view of a place.
ex: The police arrived at the scene of the accident.
警方抵達了事故現場。

en: A plan that lists the times when things will happen; or to arrange a time for something to happen.
ex: The train arrived on schedule at nine o'clock.
火車準時在九點抵達。

en: A small motorcycle with a platform for the feet; or a child's toy with two wheels that you push with one foot.
ex: Many people in Taiwan ride a scooter to work.
台灣許多人騎機車上班。

en: The number of points you get in a game or test; or to get a point or goal; or a written piece of music.
ex: She got a perfect score on the English test.
她在英語測驗中拿到滿分。

en: Fish and shellfish that are eaten as food.
ex: We had fresh seafood at a restaurant by the harbor.
我們在港邊的餐廳吃了新鮮的海鮮。

en: To try to find something by looking carefully; or an attempt to find someone or something.
ex: The police searched the building for the missing child.
警方搜尋整棟大樓尋找失蹤的孩子。

en: Less important than something else; or relating to the education of students aged 11 to 18; or coming second.
ex: She teaches English at a secondary school.
她在一所中學教英語。

en: One of the parts into which something is divided; or a separate area in a place such as a store or newspaper.
ex: The shop has a section for children's books.
這家店有一區專賣兒童書籍。

en: To try to find or get something; or to ask for something; or to try to achieve something.
ex: Many people come to the city to seek a better life.
許多人來到這座城市尋求更好的生活。

en: To give the impression of being something; or to appear to be; or to appear to do something.
ex: She seems very happy with her new job.
她似乎對新工作非常滿意。

en: A long board balanced in the middle on which two children sit and move up and down; or to move up and down or back and forth.
ex: Two children were playing on the seesaw in the park.
兩個孩子在公園玩蹺蹺板。

en: Not often; very rarely.
ex: He seldom goes out because he is always busy with work.
他很少出門，因為他總是忙著工作。

en: To choose something from a group; or to pick the best; or of high quality and limited to a few.
ex: Please select a color from the list below.
請從下面的清單中選一種顏色。

en: The act of choosing something; or a collection of things to choose from; or the things that are chosen.
ex: The shop has a wide selection of fresh fruit.
這家店有種類豐富的新鮮水果。

en: Your own person or character; or what makes you a particular person; or the individual self.
ex: She finally felt like her true self when she moved abroad.
搬到國外後，她終於覺得自己做回真正的自己。

en: Caring only about yourself and not about other people.
ex: It was selfish of him to keep all the cake for himself.
他把蛋糕全留給自己，真是自私。

en: To divide or move apart; or different or not connected; or to stop living together as a couple.
ex: Please separate the plastic from the paper before throwing them away.
丟棄前請把塑膠和紙類分開。

en: A person who is paid to do work in someone's house, such as cooking and cleaning; or a person who works for the government (a civil servant).
ex: The rich family had several servants to look after their house.
那個有錢人家有好幾個僕人照顧房子。

en: The fact of being male or female; or the physical act between two people.
ex: The form asks for your name, age and sex.
這份表格要求填寫姓名、年齡和性別。

en: A painful feeling you have when you have done something wrong or silly; or a pity; or to make someone feel this.
ex: It is a shame that the picnic was canceled because of the rain.
野餐因下雨而取消，真可惜。

en: A large, sharp-toothed sea fish that is a strong predator; or a person who cheats others out of money.
ex: The divers saw a shark swimming near the coral reef.
潛水員看見一隻鯊魚在珊瑚礁附近游動。

en: A large piece of cloth used on a bed; or a flat, thin piece of paper, glass or metal; or a wide, flat area of something.
ex: Please take a sheet of paper and write your name on it.
請拿一張紙，在上面寫下你的名字。

en: A flat board fixed to a wall or in a cupboard for putting things on.
ex: She put the books back on the shelf.
她把書放回架子上。

en: The hard outer covering of eggs, nuts, shellfish and some animals; or a bomb fired from a large gun; or to take the shell off.
ex: She collected beautiful shells on the beach.
她在海灘上撿了漂亮的貝殼。

en: To fire a gun; or to move quickly; or to film something; or to hit the ball at the goal; or a new plant growth.
ex: The striker shot the ball into the net.
前鋒把球射進網裡。

en: A person who owns or manages a small shop.
ex: The shopkeeper greeted every customer with a smile.
店主微笑著向每位顧客打招呼。

en: The land along the edge of the sea or a large lake; or to support something that might fall.
ex: The boat slowly moved toward the shore.
小船慢慢駛向岸邊。

en: The act of firing a gun; or an attempt to hit a target in sport; or an injection; or the past tense of 'shoot'.
ex: He took a shot from the corner of the pitch and scored.
他從球場角落射門得分。

en: To close something such as a door, window or box; or to stop a business for the day; or to close your eyes or mouth.
ex: Please shut the window; it is getting cold.
請把窗戶關上，天氣變冷了。

en: A complete lack of sound; or a time when no one speaks; or to make someone stop talking or making noise.
ex: The classroom fell into silence when the teacher walked in.
老師走進來時，教室一片寂靜。

en: Showing a lack of good sense; or childish; or foolish in a funny way.
ex: It was silly of me to forget my homework again.
我又忘了帶功課，真是太傻了。

en: In a plain way, without anything special; or only; or used to emphasize that something is true.
ex: I did it simply because I wanted to help.
我這麼做純粹是因為想幫忙。

en: Not married; or only one; or for one person only; or a ticket for one direction only.
ex: He booked a single room at the hotel for two nights.
他在旅館訂了兩晚單人房。

en: The ability to do something well, usually gained through training or practice.
ex: Cooking is a useful skill that everyone should learn.
烹飪是每個人都該學的有用技能。

en: Having the ability and experience needed to do something well; or requiring special training.
ex: The restaurant hired a skilled chef from France.
這家餐廳聘請了一位來自法國的技術純熟的廚師。

en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body; or the outer layer of fruit; or to remove the skin from something.
ex: She uses a special cream to take care of her skin.
她用一種特殊乳霜保養肌膚。

en: Feeling that you want to sleep; or quiet and with little activity.
ex: The children were sleepy after a long day at the beach.
孩子們在海灘玩了一整天後都想睡了。

en: To slide by accident and fall or almost fall; or to move quietly or secretly; or a small mistake; or a piece of paper.
ex: He slipped on the wet floor and hurt his back.
他在濕地板上滑倒，傷了背。

en: A soft, comfortable shoe that you wear indoors.
ex: He took off his shoes and put on a pair of slippers.
他脫掉鞋子，穿上一雙拖鞋。

en: A small amount of food eaten between meals; or to eat small amounts of food between meals.
ex: I usually have a snack in the afternoon.
我下午通常會吃點心。
